name: TOPReward
note: Reference implementation and evaluation tooling for extracting dense task-progress signals from pretrained video-language models.

name: MolmoAct 2
note: Pretraining data-quality filtering using TOPReward thresholding, and value-head work, for an open action-reasoning model family released with models, data, and evaluation rollouts.

name: UniPose9D
note: Implementation and pretrained models for category-agnostic 9D object pose estimation from RGB and RGB-D input, with no mesh, category label, or reference view required.

name: LeRobot
note: TOPReward and MolmoAct 2 integrations into Hugging Face's robotics library, plus fixes for Koch 1.1 hardware and setup failure modes.

name: MeGPT
note: A QLoRA fine-tuning pipeline for training a personalized Llama-based chatbot from private message history.
